aioInputs.name: repairType
aioInputs.description: Type of engine repair (dropdown: minor repair, head gasket, timing belt/chain, engine rebuild, engine replacement)

aioInputs.name: engineSize
aioInputs.description: Engine displacement or cylinder count (e.g. 4-cyl, V6, V8) — affects parts cost and labor hours

aioInputs.name: vehicleAge
aioInputs.description: Vehicle age in years — affects parts availability and whether rebuild vs replace is cost-effective

aioInputs.name: laborRate
aioInputs.description: Shop labor rate in $/hr — varies by region and shop type; default pre-filled from BLS regional median (~$100–$130/hr)

aioInputs.name: shopType
aioInputs.description: Shop tier (dropdown: dealership, independent shop, DIY) — largest single cost lever

aioInputs.name: partsTier
aioInputs.description: Parts quality (dropdown: OEM, aftermarket, remanufactured) — affects parts cost 20–40%

aioInputs.name: engineCondition
aioInputs.description: For replacement: new crate engine, remanufactured, or used pull — drives parts cost range

aioOutputs.name: totalEstimatedCost
aioOutputs.description: All-in estimated repair cost in dollars (parts + labor)

aioOutputs.name: partsSubtotal
aioOutputs.description: Parts cost subtotal — so the user can compare shop quotes

aioOutputs.name: laborSubtotal
aioOutputs.description: Labor cost subtotal based on flat-rate hours × shop rate

aioOutputs.name: laborHours
aioOutputs.description: Estimated flat-rate hours for this repair type

aioOutputs.name: repairVsReplaceSignal
aioOutputs.description: Flag when repair cost approaches 50–75% of vehicle value — recommends replacement instead

aioProseQuestions: How much does it cost to repair an engine?
Is it cheaper to rebuild or replace an engine?
How much does a head gasket repair cost?
What is the average labor rate for engine repair?
How do I know if my engine is worth fixing?
aioIncludesExcludes: Estimate covers parts and labor for the selected repair type; excludes diagnostic fees, towing, rental car, taxes, and any secondary repairs uncovered during teardown.
aioDisclaimer: Actual shop quotes vary by region and vehicle condition — use this estimate as a negotiating baseline, not a final price.
